scripts.build: npm run build:pure && npm run build:content-ts && npm run build:fetch && npm run build:background-src && npm run build:sw && npm run build:host && npm run build:content-bridge && npm run build:app-parts && npm run build:modal
scripts.package: PRP_RELEASE=1 npm run build && PRP_RELEASE=1 node scripts/package-extension.mjs
scripts.browser:solo: node --input-type=module -e "import { ensureSingleTab } from './tests/e2e/lib/ab.mjs'; const r=ensureSingleTab(); console.log('solo tab', r)"
scripts.browser:login: agent-browser close --all 2>/dev/null; agent-browser open https://github.com/login; npm run browser:solo
scripts.browser:pulls: agent-browser close --all 2>/dev/null; agent-browser open https://github.com/enif-lee/pr-plus/pulls; npm run browser:solo
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.fetch.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.bridge.json && node scripts/typecheck-entries.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.typecheck:all-projects: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.fetch.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.bridge.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.entries.json
